nodes.Name: recType
nodes.DocComment:
recType is a record type, as defined by
https://web.archive.org/web/20150420080736/http://www.fastcgi.com/drupal/node/6?q=node/22#S8

nodes.Name: flagKeepConn
nodes.DocComment: keep the connection between web-server and responder open after request

nodes.Name: pad
nodes.DocComment:
for padding so we don't have to allocate all the time
not synchronized because we don't care what the contents are

nodes.Name: Close
nodes.DocComment: Close closes the conn if it is not already closed.

nodes.Name: writeRecord
nodes.DocComment: writeRecord writes and sends a single record.

nodes.Name: bufWriter
nodes.DocComment:
bufWriter encapsulates bufio.Writer but also closes the underlying stream when
Closed.

nodes.Name: streamWriter
nodes.DocComment:
streamWriter abstracts out the separation of a stream into discrete records.
It only writes maxWrite bytes at a time.
